summary: Tests the saved link format. It checks that a job and project identity survive a round trip, and that unsafe or unknown addresses are rejected.
purpose: Protects the link reading and writing code.
why: Likely reason: links come from the address bar, so bad input must be refused safely.
how: Writes a link for a job and project and reads it back. Checks that a job-only link has no project. Then checks four unsafe or unknown addresses return nothing.
risks: Covers only the listed bad examples.
